Biography

Tenor, Composer, Researcher, Educator & Arts Executive

Emmanuel Solomon is a versatile and acclaimed tenor, composer, and arts administrator known for his compelling vocal artistry and dedication to music as a tool for social development.

With a career that bridges North America, Europe, Asia and West Africa, he currently serves as the Executive Director of Bikkurim Studios Inc., a performing arts organization that fosters the appreciation of arts education and performance in Ottawa Ontario Canada.
